items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: Well I worked there with Georgie Parker, Happy Landing. I worked there about four or five years straight.

ctx.x: Who did you work there with?

Well I worked there with Georgie Parker, Happy Landing. I worked there about four or five years straight. Who else was in the band? Yeah, they had, let's see, Elmer Talbot was on trumpet and what you call him was on banjo was, well we call him Father Calley. He played, he played Father Calley. Father Calley, he played Father Calley we called him. He played guitar. And let's see, who was on the trombone, we have a trombone, yeah we have a trombone. Let's see who that was.
Well that's alright, do you remember any of the brass bands and trades when you were a kid?
